issues.description: PR title and CHANGELOG mismatch the actual check ID
issues.detail: The PR title says compute_image_publicly_shared but the directory, file, class, and metadata CheckID all use compute_image_not_publicly_shared. The description's 'Check (compute_image_publicly_shared/)' reference is inconsistent. Confirm the CHANGELOG entry name matches the actual CheckID registered, and align PR description to avoid downstream confusion.

issues.description: Image with failed IAM policy fetch is silently reported as PASS
issues.detail: In _get_images, when getIamPolicy raises (e.g., permission denied as in test-image-3), publicly_shared defaults to False and the image is appended. The check then reports PASS for an image whose sharing status is unknown. This produces false negatives. Consider skipping the image or surfacing an indeterminate/error state instead.

issues.description: Images fetched after threading completes are not threaded across projects
issues.detail: Every other resource collection uses __threading_call__, but _get_images iterates project_ids serially. On accounts with many projects this will be significantly slower than peer methods and inconsistent with the established pattern in the file.

issues.description: Provider permissions not updated for images.getIamPolicy
issues.detail: The PR checklist explicitly calls out reviewing provider permissions when adding new checks. The new code calls images().list and images().getIamPolicy, but no permission/role manifest update is shown in the diff. If Prowler maintains a documented required-permissions list for GCP, it needs to add compute.images.list and compute.images.getIamPolicy.

issues.description: Public-images filter not applied; check evaluates all images including Google-owned families
issues.detail: images().list(project=project_id) only returns custom images in the user's project, but the description says 'custom images' — worth confirming no public/deprecated family images leak in (filter=deprecated.state!=DEPRECATED could be useful). Also no pagination edge case test exists; list_next is mocked to None.

issues.description: Report missing location/region context and uses image name as resource
issues.detail: Images are global GCP resources, which is fine, but Check_Report_GCP is constructed with resource=image (Pydantic model). Verify Check_Report_GCP correctly extracts resource_id/name from the Image model (tests assert resource_id=image.id, resource_name=image.name), which depends on framework conventions — confirm Image model field naming matches what Check_Report_GCP expects (e.g., uid vs id).

review.summary: The check is straightforward and well-tested, but has a notable correctness gap: when IAM policy retrieval fails (e.g., permission denied), the image is silently reported as PASS rather than an error/skip — a false negative for a security check. There are also consistency issues: image collection runs serially while every other resource uses __threading_call__, and the PR description/title diverge from the actual CheckID (compute_image_not_publicly_shared). Provider permissions for images.getIamPolicy may need to be added to documentation. Minor concerns around image filtering and Check_Report_GCP field expectations are worth a quick verification before merge.
